newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hylsamex unit closes loan facility.
newsitem.headline: Hylsamex unit closes loan facility.

text.p: Hylsa SA, the largest subsidiary of steel giant Hylsamex SA, said Wednesday it closed a $125 million syndicated loan facility designed to backstop Hylsa's $175 million five-year note maturing in February 1998.

Hylsamex said in a statement that the facility may be drawn down only to repurchase or repay the note upon maturity. Loans drawn under the facility would have a three year tenor, including one year grace period and five equal amortization payments.
The backstop facility was led by J.P. Morgan Securities as arranger, with Bankers Trust Co, Midland Bank Plc and Swiss Bank Corp, New York branch, acting as co-arrangers.
